summary: fractal-web enforces a Content Security Policy in the app server and Vite development/preview servers so agent-selected remote images cannot load even after a Markdown renderer regression

replay.detail: Response-header enforcement only; no runtime replay change.

compatibility.detail: The CSP may block cross-origin resources that were not used before. Images are restricted to same-origin, data and blob URLs; deferred remote-image actions open the original URL in a new tab with noopener,noreferrer instead of loading inline. External OTLP collectors require an explicit exact connect origin. Inline application scripts use hashes, and cross-origin Vite HMR is rejected.

manual.detail: No deployed installation action required; the app is not deployed by this change.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
